supporting_pages.title: Explore BigQuery in the Google Cloud console \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: The Studio page has the following components: Explorer tab of the left pane : use the Explorer tab to work with tables, views, routines, and other BigQuery resources, and view your job history .
Query data using split tabs To split tabs when querying tables, follow these steps: In the Explorer menu, click the table that you want to query.
The Explorer pane lists different code assets and data resources, and it lets you search for BigQuery resources.
